# MDL504 · `masquerade-syntax`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A masking function's arguments make mydumper stop, or misbehave.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | tables |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | — |
| Design references | F11 |

## Why

mydumper parses masking arguments with hand-written loops. A missing quote or `>`, an unknown `<tag>`, the wrong number of `apply` or `regex` arguments, an invalid pattern, or `REPLACE_NULL 0` (from v0.21.4-1) abort mydumper at startup, while it loads its table sections. A function without its arguments makes mydumper read past the end of the value, and any token of 256 bytes or more overflows a fixed buffer: the outcome is unpredictable.

## Example

With mydumper v1.0.5-1:

❌ Before:

```ini
[`app`.`users`]
`a`=apply 'x' 'y' 'z'
`b`=apply 'x
`c`=regex '^(a' 'b'
`d`=regex 'a'
`e`=random_format <nope 3>
`f`=random_format <string 5
`g`=apply
`h`=random_string REPLACE_NULL 0
`i`=random_int MAX_LENGTH
```

```text
2:11-2:22 error MDL504[masquerade-syntax] apply takes 1 or 2 quoted arguments, not 3 ("Parsing apply function failed")
  = mydumper aborts at startup, while it loads its table sections.
3:11-3:13 error MDL504[masquerade-syntax] a quote is not closed ("Parsing format failed missing quote (')")
  = mydumper aborts at startup, while it loads its table sections.
4:12-4:15 error MDL504[masquerade-syntax] the pattern `^(a` does not compile (error parsing regexp: missing closing ) in `^(a`; checked with a PCRE-like engine)
  = mydumper aborts at startup, while it loads its table sections.
5:11-5:14 error MDL504[masquerade-syntax] regex takes pairs of quoted arguments (pattern, replacement), not 1 ("Parsing regex function failed")
  = mydumper aborts at startup, while it loads its table sections.
6:19-6:27 error MDL504[masquerade-syntax] <nope 3> is not a tag mydumper knows: <file F>, <string N>, <number N> or <regex '…'> ("Parsing format failed key inside <tag> not valid")
  = mydumper aborts at startup, while it loads its table sections.
7:19-7:28 error MDL504[masquerade-syntax] a <tag> is not closed ("Parsing format failed missing close character (>)")
  = mydumper aborts at startup, while it loads its table sections.
8:5-8:10 error MDL504[masquerade-syntax] `apply` has no arguments: mydumper reads them from byte 7 of the value, past its end
  = mydumper reads or writes out of bounds: the masking is unpredictable, and mydumper may crash.
9:19-9:33 error MDL504[masquerade-syntax] REPLACE_NULL needs a positive length right after one space ("REPLACE_NULL receives an integer value as paramter")
  = mydumper aborts at startup, while it loads its table sections.
10:16-10:26 error MDL504[masquerade-syntax] MAX_LENGTH needs an argument: mydumper reads it past the end of the value
  = mydumper reads or writes out of bounds: the masking is unpredictable, and mydumper may crash.
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL504: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL504` on the line above it.
